name: Civic GovUK Cookie Control
description: GOV.UK / DWP Design System styled cookie-consent banner and details blocks built on Civic Cookie Control.
project_description: Civic GovUK Cookie Control integrates the Civic Cookie Control module with the DWP Design System / GOV.UK cookie-consent pattern, for use with public-facing DWP (UK government) services. It provides a GOV.UK-styled cookie banner block and a cookie-details block (for the cookie policy page), plus a small settings form to customise and translate the pattern's button and message text. Configure the parent Civic Cookie Control module as usual (API key, cookie categories, privacy statement node) first; then place the two blocks. A working example of DWP is included in the Pensions Ombudsman website.
